title: WorkflowRecipe
description: Declarative SDLC workflow recipe — a named ordered list of phases with optional match rules and budget caps.

name.description: Unique identifier (kebab-case). Used as the --workflow=NAME argument value.

match.description: Deterministic signals for auto-selecting this recipe (Iteration 1+). Absent in Iteration 0.

arguments_pattern.description: ECMAScript regex source, compiled with flags 'iu', tested against $ARGUMENTS. Consulted only by RESOLVER.md Step 1 rule 4 (match scan for recipes with no task_type mapping) — never by rule 3 (task_type-mapped recipes), where it would silently override the authoritative classification in GIT-FLOW.md Step C. Do not use \b: ECMAScript \w is [A-Za-z0-9_], so \b never asserts a boundary next to non-Latin characters, with or without the 'u' flag. Use (?<![\p{L}\p{N}]) / (?![\p{L}\p{N}]) instead — see plugins/sdlc/references/task-type-patterns.json for the boundary convention and worked examples.

loc_touched_max.description: Recipe matches only when LOC_TOUCHED <= this value.

loc_touched_min.description: Recipe matches only when LOC_TOUCHED >= this value.

has_migrations.description: If true, recipe matches only when HAS_MIGRATIONS == true.

config_only.description: If true, recipe matches only when CONFIG_ONLY == true.

phases.description: Ordered list of pipeline steps. Each element is a phase-name string, an object with name + optional when, or a {parallel: [...]} group whose members run concurrently. Phase numbering (Phase N/total) counts steps, so every member of a group shares one N.

oneOf.description: A parallel group: members dispatched concurrently as one pipeline step. Groups do not nest.

parallel.description: Two or more phases to run concurrently. A one-member group is expressed as a plain phase instead.

caps.description: Hard limits for a run of this workflow.

max_total_cost_usd.description: Pipeline halts (with user confirmation) if estimated cost exceeds this value.

when.description: Conditional expression evaluated after BA output (Iteration 3+). Example: 'complexity == large'.

phaseMember.description: A single phase: a name string, or {name, when}.
